summary: Teleflex entered into a $250 million accelerated share repurchase (ASR) with Truist Bank on August 7, 2026, under its previously announced $1 billion buyback program. Payment on August 10, 2026, delivers initial shares valued at 80% of the repurchase price based on the August 6 closing price. Final settlement uses volume-weighted average prices, with potential additional shares or cash adjustments. Termination is scheduled for Q4 2026. Funding comes from proceeds of the divestiture of its OEM business. Watch for final share count and potential early termination.
